answer: Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes — coordination requires many low-weight votes that cancel each other out. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. Consider a violet as the anchor of the cost. A dawn stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a ridge...
